# Observability, Auditability, and Testing Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the evidence and test requirements (domains 10 Observability and auditability, 11 TDD and testing)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) §7, §10

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Observability and Auditability

- [ ] CHK001 Does the audited-event list cover transitions, decisions, retries, failures, fallbacks, compensation, replanning, policy evaluations, and terminal outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-AUD-01] Detects: incomplete audit evidence. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the mandatory audit fields specified (run id, actor type, actor, action, timestamp, target, result, reason)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-AUD-01, Constitution IX] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is correlation-id propagation specified for API requests and runs, including in logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OPS-04, §FR-AUD-05] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is each reliability metric defined with a formula and a population? [Clarity, Spec §FR-AUD-04, Plan §7] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is MTTR defined to exclude unrecovered failures from the denominator, with unrecovered failures reported separately? [Clarity, Spec §FR-AUD-04, Plan §7] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the MTTR timestamps (detected, recovery start, recovery complete) defined for each failure type, including timeouts and interruptions? [Clarity, Plan §7 MTTR capture, data-model.md FailureEvent] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Are exclusions from the measurement population enumerated with reasons? [Completeness, Plan §7] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is labeling of demonstration measurements required wherever metrics are presented? [Clarity, Constitution IX, Spec §SC-008] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is end-to-end latency defined with respect to time spent waiting for humans? [Clarity, Plan §7] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified that a run's history can be reconstructed from persisted evidence alone? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-OBS-01] [Mandatory]

## TDD and Testing

- [ ] CHK011 Does the plan require red-green-refactor with recorded evidence of the expected failing run? [Completeness, Constitution IV, Plan §10] Detects: implementation preceding specification or tests. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is every test category the constitution lists mapped to requirements? [Coverage, Plan §10, Constitution IV] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Are negative and failure-path tests required for each governance and reliability control? [Coverage, Plan §10] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Are concurrency test scenarios specified with quantities (200 concurrent redirects; exactly N successes for a click limit of N)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §SCN-B AC-3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Is test determinism addressed (clock control, no fixed sleeps, independent contexts)? [Clarity, Plan §10, ADR-013] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the coverage target quantified and scoped to named packages? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-TST-01, PVT-23, ADR-013] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is contract validation specified as executed against real responses rather than asserted in documentation? [Measurability, Plan §2 deliverables, ADR-013] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "complete only after executed validation" required, with a defined location for the execution evidence? [Completeness, Constitution XI, Plan §10] Detects: unsupported completion claims. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the handling of flaky or order-dependent tests defined? [Gap, Plan §10] [Enhancement]
- [ ] CHK020 Are performance measurements specified as labeled demonstration measurements with a stated load profile? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-PRF-01, PVT-19/20] [Enhancement]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Review owner: the human candidate (Gates G2/G4)
